summary: Notes conditionals work with reusable task files, playbooks and roles, but behave differently for dynamic includes versus static imports.
questions: Do conditionals behave differently on includes and imports?

answer_card.title: Conditionals with includes vs imports
answer_card.answer_md: You can put conditionals on reusable task files, playbooks and roles, but Ansible evaluates them differently for **dynamic includes** and **static imports**.
